# Generated Gazebo models: do not edit

Every model here is written by `ros2 run lab_replica build_models.py` (and by
`replan_problem.py`) from `config/cell.yaml`, `config/items.yaml` and the
object files in `lab_replica/objects/`. Hand edits are overwritten. To change
a dimension, edit the YAML files; to change a shape, edit the object's file.
